verdict.rationale: Khoj's docs explicitly confirm voice chat: users can talk to Khoj via voice and it responds using the same chat models (implying transcription of voice input and spoken/text replies). However, there's no evidence of live/continuous voice conversation mode, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of voice quality or reliability. Missing for 10: evidence of live voice conversation support, independent hands-on validation of voice transcription/response accuracy, details on which clients support voice.
